question: What is the best way to disinfect the floor of the cattle shed after yesterday's rain?
answer:
नमस्कार,

वर्दुच्या पाऊस नंतर गौशालेतील फळी रोगनिरोधकासाठी खालील प्रमाणित पद्धतीचा वापर करावा. पावसात ओलावा आणि मुरलेली शेण-कचरा यांमुळे विषाणू आणि जीवाणूंची संख्या वाढते, त्यामुळे योग्य स्वच्छता करणे अत्यंत आवश्यक आहे.

### **गौशालेतील फळी रोगनिरोधक करण्याची योग्य पद्धत:**

#### **१. आधी पूर्ण साफसफाई (Cleaning):**
   - सर्व शेण, कचरा, उरलेले चारा आणि इतर दूषित पदार्थ काढून टाका.
   - शेणाचे ढेर तयार करून ठेवा जेणेकरून त्यात होणारी उष्णता जीवाणूंना मारण्यास मदत करेल.
   - फळी, भिंती (ज्याची उंची १.५ मीटरपर्यंत), पिण्याचे तळ आणि खाऊ घालण्याचे ठिकाण हे पाण्याने धुवा.

#### **२. रासायनिक वि dezinfekant (Chemical Disinfectants):**
साफसफाई केलेल्या फळीवर खालीलपैकी कोणतेही एक वि dezinfekant वापरा:

- **४% वॉशिंग सोडा द्रावण (Washing Soda Solution):**  
  १०० लिटर उकळत्या पाण्यात ४ किलो वॉशिंग सोडा मिसळा. या द्रावणाने फळी स्प्रे करा किंवा लाटून धुवा. हे २४ तास काम करू देऊन नंतर स्वच्छ पाण्याने धुवा.

- **१-२% फेनॉल (Phenol) किंवा २% सोडियम हायपोक्लोराइट (Bleach):**  
  हे द्रावण फवारणी मार्फत वापरावे.

- **लिम्पाउंडर (Lime Powder/Whitewash):**  
  चुना पावडर किंवा ब्रश लावून फळीचे कोरडे करणे देखील उपयुक्त ठरते.

#### **३. सूर्यप्रकाश आणि हवा (Sunlight and Air):**
- रसायने लावल्यानंतर गौशाला खुले ठेवून सूर्यप्रकाश आणि हवा येऊ दे. सूर्यप्रकाश हा प्राकृतिक रोगनिरोधक आहे.

#### **४. फवारणी (Spraying):**
- गरजेनुसार कीटकनाशके किंवा परजीवी नियंत्रणासाठी फवारणी करा.

### **महत्वाच्या टीपा:**
- वि dezinfekant लावण्यापूर्वी फळी पूर्णपणे स्वच्छ असणे आवश्यक आहे, कारण मुरलेला कचरा रसायनांचा परिणाम कमी करतो.
- पावसाळ्यात ओलावा असल्याने काळपुळी रोग (Black Quarter) आणि इतर मातीशी संबंधित संसर्गांचा धोका वाढतो, म्हणून फळीची रोगनिरोधक ही अत्यंत महत्त्वाची आहे.
- दर आठवड्याला एकदा फळीचे नियमित धुणे आणि चिनाची पांढरी गोंद लावणे ही उत्तम सवयी आहेत.

Disinfection protocol for cattle [गाय वर्ग] sheds
- Under normal circumstances, daily scrubbing and washing of the floors, water troughs and mangers and the action of sunlight falling in the houses are sufficient enough to keep them moderately germ free. This should be supplemented with periodic white washing of the walls, mangers and troughs.
- When there is a disease outbreak [रोग उद्रेक], a more elaborate procedure of disinfection should be followed. All floors, walls up to the height of 1.5 m, interior of water trough [पिण्याचे तळ], mangers, other fittings and equipment coming in contact with animals should be disinfected.

Material (swabs or tissues or contents of lesion and tubular organ) for microbiological examination should be collected in aseptic conditions. The materials obtained can be sent without preservatives [संरक्षक (Preservatives)] i.e. on ice or in transport medium.

- 3. Use freshly sterilized equipments and containers.
- 4. Collected materials are sent in refrigerated condition (+ 4oC ) on ice.
- 5. Materials may also be sent using preservatives [संरक्षक (Preservatives)].

Bacteriology

Amies transport medium with charcoal or Stuart transport medium without charcoal.

Virology

Dispatch [नमुना पाठविणे] the material within 24 hours under refrigerated condition on ice.

c. Water borne diseases: Through ingestion of water. eg. Colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस], Infectious Hepatitis, Leptospirosis [लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस].

2. Inhalation
```


----

**Manual on Management Gaushala**
```
Practices for minimizing disease incidence [रोग प्रादुर्भाव]
- Provide an appropriate housing [निवास व्यवस्था] facility with adequate space for all animals.
- Avoid temperature [तापमान] extremes and fluctuations to keep it within animal's comfort zones.
- Practice good sanitation at all times. Manure [खत] should be removed as frequently as practical.
- New animals [नवीन पशू] coming into the *gaushala* should be checked and vaccinated against endemic diseases.
- Isolate all new animals [नवीन पशू] for a sufficient period (minimum 21 days) before allowing full entry into the *gaushala*
- Ensure that animals always have an adequate quantity of feed and fodder [खाद्य आणि चारा], appropriate to age and physiological stage.
- Provide ample, potable water, with space for at least 10% of housed cattle [गाय वर्ग] to drink at any one time.
- Protect feed and water from fecal and other environmental contamination.
- Do not mix different age groups of animals.
- Daily observe all animals for abnormal behaviour or other signs of disease [रोग].
- Begin treatment [उपचार] quickly whenever diseases are detected.

Cattle [गाय वर्ग] diseases prevalent in India

The following cattle [गाय वर्ग] diseases have been identified as important endemic diseases in India. Therefore a regular vaccination [लसीकरण] programme, parasite control [परजीवी नियंत्रण] programme and prophylactic measures are important against these diseases.
- Foot and mouth disease [खुर व तोंड रोग]
- Haemorrhagic septicaemia
- Black quarter [काळपुळी रोग]
- Anthrax [अँथ्रॅक्स]
- Enterotoxaemia
- Cow [गाय] pox [देवी]
- Brucellosis [ब्रुसॅलोसिस]
- Rabies
- Parasitic diseases (fascioliasis, amphistomiasis, schistosomiasis)
- Protozoan diseases (babesiosis, theileriosis [थायलेरीओसिस], anaplasmosis [अ‍ॅनाप्लास्मोसिस], trypanosomiasis, coccidiosis [कॉक्सिडिओसिस])
- Tuberculosis [क्षयरोग]
- Mange infestations
- Mastitis [स्तनदाह]
```


----

**STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY**
```
Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] is based on isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and identification of *E. coli* from lesions typical of colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस]. Care must be taken to avoid faecal contamination of samples. Material should be streaked on eosin-methylene blue (EMB) or MacConkey agar, as well as noninhibitory media. A presumptive diagnosis [निदान] of *E. coli* infection [संसर्ग] can be made if most of the colonies are characteristically dark with a metallic sheen on EMB agar and bright pink with a precipitate surrounding the colonies on MacConkey agar. Strains of *E. coli* can be slow or non-lactose fermenters and appear as non-lactose fermenting colonies. Multiplex PCR [पीसीआर] for 6 virulence genes of *E. coli* help to distinguish between commensal and pathogenic isolates.

Treatment [उपचार]

Antimicrobial therapy - as per the antimicrobial sensitivity test - under the supervision of the poultry [कुक्कुट] veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक] along with supportive therapy [सहायक उपचार] will reduce the losses in clinical infection [संसर्ग]. Strict withdrawal period should be followed after administration of antibiotics. Water sanitation and acidification of feed and water helps in prevention [प्रतिबंध].

Control

Proper breeder [संकरक] farm and hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] hygiene [स्वच्छता] and sanitization. Feed hygiene [आहार स्वच्छता] and gut health management [आरोग्य व्यवस्थापन].
```


----

**STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY**
```
Treatment [उपचार]

Antimicrobial therapy - as per the antimicrobial sensitivity test - under the supervision of the poultry [कुक्कुट] veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक] along with supportive therapy [सहायक उपचार] will reduce the losses in clinical infection [संसर्ग]. Strict withdrawal period should be followed after administration of antibiotics. Water sanitation and acidification of feed and water helps in prevention [प्रतिबंध].

Control

Proper breeder [संकरक] farm and hatchery [अंडी उबवणूक केंद्र] hygiene [स्वच्छता] and sanitization. Feed hygiene [आहार स्वच्छता] and gut health management [आरोग्य व्यवस्थापन].

Prevention [प्रतिबंध]/Biosecurity [जैवसुरक्षा]

Feed contamination with *E. coli* can be a source of infection [संसर्ग] for poultry [कुक्कुट]. Hence, it is advisable to use acidifiers (organic [सेंद्रिय] acids, pre- and pro-biotics (competitive exclusion)) and essential oils [आवश्यक तेल] as per recommended doses in the feed to maintain the gut integrity and reduce the *E. coli* contamination.

Water hygiene [स्वच्छता] includes following steps:
- Regular administration of water sanitizers such as Chlorine dioxide@0.2 ml/L
- Use of water acidifiers to reduce the pH.
- Regular removal of biofilms in the pipelines by using 10% H2 O2 .
- Ensure regular care of clean drinking water [स्वच्छ पाणी देणे] pipes.
- Rodent, insect [कीटक], and pest control [कीड नियंत्रण].
- Personal hygiene [स्वच्छता] of farm workers.
- Avoiding open defecation in farm premises.
- Regular cleaning [साफसफाई] and disinfection of poultry [कुक्कुट]

sheds can help to reduce the environmental buildup of *E. coli.*

Waste disposal in a poultry [कुक्कुट] farm is important to check further infection [संसर्ग]. Various steps include used poultry [कुक्कुट] litter [कचरा], carcasses, and other potentially contaminated farm waste should be transported and disposed of in a safe manner (deep burial, incineration or composting [खतनिर्मिती]) to prevent the direct or indirect exposure of humans, livestock [पशुधन] and wildlife to *E. coli*.
```


----

**STANDARD VETERINARY TREATMENT GUIDELINES FOR LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY**
```
Differential Diagnosis [निदान]

Buffalopox must be differentiated from cowpox; bovine herpes mammillitis; pseudocowpox; foot and mouth disease [खुर व तोंड रोग].

Treatment [उपचार]

No specific treatment [उपचार] is advised, but palliative treatment [उपचार] including antibiotics (penicillin G @ 10,000-60,000 IU/kg BW IM; amoxicillin-sulbactum @ 5-10 mg/kg BW IM; enrofloxacin @ 3-5 mg/kg BW IM) to treat secondary bacterial infections, NSAIDS (meloxicam @ 0.2-0.5 mg/kg BW IM) for management [व्यवस्थापन] of fever [ताप] and pain [वेदना], supportive therapy [सहायक उपचार] with antioxidants (vitamin C @ 3 g SC; and B-complex @10-15 ml IM) and wound [जखम] dressing with potassium [पालाश] permanganate solution (0.01percent) may be necessary in severely affected animals.

The validated ethnoveterinary medicine practices for treatment [उपचार] of skin [त्वचा] lesions due to buffalopox are in use to reduce the irrational use of antibiotics/medicines and thereby reducing the cost of treatment [उपचार].

Prevention [प्रतिबंध] and Control

Control of buffalopox relies on a combination of vaccination [लसीकरण], hygiene [स्वच्छता], and management [व्यवस्थापन] practices. Vaccination [लसीकरण] with live attenuated vaccines provides protection. Isolate affected animals to prevent the spread of the virus. Regular disinfection of housing [निवास व्यवस्था], equipment, and milking [दूध काढणे] areas to reduce environmental contamination. Control of mechanical vectors like flies [माशी] through the use of insecticides [कीटकनाशके] and proper waste management [व्यवस्थापन].

Biosecurity Measures [जैव सुरक्षा उपाय]

New animals [नवीन पशू] should be quarantined and monitored for signs of disease [रोग] before being introduced to the herd [पशूंचे झुंड]. Farm workers should practice good personal hygiene [स्वच्छता], including handwashing and changing clothing after handling animals. Regular cleaning [साफसफाई] and disinfection of equipment and vehicles that come into contact with animals. Restricting access to the farm and ensuring visitors follow biosecurity [जैवसुरक्षा] protocols.
```


----

**Manual on Management Gaushala**
```
Disinfestation protocol

Disinfestation comprises eliminating sources of parasitic infection [संसर्ग], preventing animals from getting access to possible sources of infestations and elimination of

intermediate hosts. The following protocol may be followed for the disinfestation of *gaushal* premises.
- Prompt and proper disposal of manure [खत] and other filth from the *gaushala* premises.
- Regular scrubbing and cleaning [साफसफाई] of feed and water troughs as well as white washing their interior at least once in a week.
- Levelling up all ditches, low muddy areas, pits etc. in and around animal houses so that water may not stagnate in them.
- Filling up or fencing of all stagnant water pools, ponds etc. around the *gaushala* and on grazing [चरणे] areas so that animals may not get access to them.
- Housing [निवास व्यवस्था] animals in clean houses with paved floors. Animals of different ages should be housed separately. Younger animals should never be mixed with older ones. Animals of same age should be managed as a single, closed community.
- Proper deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] of all such animals before putting them in a shed [निवारा] or bringing them into the *gaushala*.
- If grazing [चरणे] is practised-division [विभाग] of pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] into several blocks and practising rotational grazing [चरणे] in these blocks.
- Preventing humans from defecating on grazing [चरणे] fields as this may cause contamination with tapeworm eggs [अंडी]. Care should be taken to see that dogs (intermediate hosts), crows and other birds (mechanical carriers) do not gain access to the *gaushala.*

Waste disposal from *gaushala*

Gaushala waste should be promptly and completely removed from sheds so that it may not cause any disease [रोग]. It should be well conserved in the form of farm manure [खत] so that it may not loose plant nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] and it should conveniently be applied to lands.
```


----

**Animal Science and Technology Standard XII**
```
Causative agent

 The disease [रोग] is caused by a protozoa namely *Trypanosoma evansi*.

Transmission

 It is transmitted through the bites of flies [माशी] mainly of *Tabanus* species [प्रजाती].

Symptoms [लक्षणे]

(a) Acute form

- 1. Fever [ताप]
- 2. Circling movements
- 3. In-coordination
- 4. Head pressing against hard objects
- 5. Blindness
- 6. Convulsions and death

(b) Chronic form

- 1. Intermittent fever [ताप]
- 2. Poor appetite [भूक]
- 3. Drop in milk production [दूध उत्पादन]
- 4. Loss of body weight [शरीराचे वजन] (Fig [अंजीर]: 8.12)
- 5. Anaemia [रक्तहीनता]

Fig [अंजीर]. 8.12 : Trypanosomosis in horse [घोडा]

Control

- 1. Control of vectors like flies [माशी].
- 2. Hygienic and sanitary measures
- 3. Detection, isolation [अलग ठेवणे] and treatment [उपचार] of infected animals.
- 4. Prophylactic chemotherapy with quinapyramine in area where disease [रोग] commonly occurs
```


----

**Krushi VNMAU**
```
6. **Parthenium (Gajar Gavat):** It is necessary to take the following measures to control Parthenium.
    1. Preventive
    2. Curative
    3. Eradicative
        1. **Preventive:** Pull out this weed by the roots before it flowers. Remove Parthenium before flowering at compost [कंपोस्ट] pits, irrigation [सिंचन] ridges, canals, railway lines, roads, etc.
        2. **Curative:** Remove Parthenium growing in standing crops by uprooting it completely by weeding [तण काढणे] or hoeing [डवरणे]. Weedicide [तणनाशक] recommendations are available for the control of weeds [तण] in different crops; follow them. For Parthenium growing in fallow land [पडीक जमीन], spray 2, 4 D herbicide [तणनाशक] (Sodium salt [मीठ]) @ 3 kg or Glyphosate @ 3 Ltrs mixed in 500 Ltrs of water before it flowers. If necessary, spray again at the same rate after 10 to 15 days.
        3. **Eradicative:** Parthenium should be repeatedly removed collectively by all concerned and institutions before it flowers.
```

question: गायीला ताप आणि खाणे बंद झाले आहे, काय करावे?
answer:
सध्या तुमच्या ठिकाणी पशुवैद्य किंवा कृषी अधिकाऱ्यांचा संपर्क क्रमांक उपलब्ध नाही. तरीही, कृपया खालील पायऱ्या अवश्य करा:

**तातडीने करावे लागणारे उपाय:**
- गायीला पाण्याचा थंड आटा (cold water) पितो का ते तपासा. जर न पिती असेल, तर थोडे थंड पाणी घट्ट पिटवून द्या.
- गायीच्या नाकातून सासणे बंद झाले आहे का याची तपासणी करा.
- गायीच्या शरीरावर ताप मोजण्यासाठी हाताने स्पर्श करून पाहा.

**काय टाळावे:**
- गायीला कोणतेही घरगुती औषध किंवा इतर जनावरांसाठी वापरलेली औषधे देऊ नका.
- गायीला एकाच जागी रक्कम ठेवू नका, कारण यामुळे आजार अधिक वाढू शकतो.

**जवळच्या पशुवैद्याशी संपर्क साधा:**
तुम्ही तुमच्या गावातील **पशुधन विभाग**, **व्हेटरिनेरी हॉस्पिटल** किंवा **आरोग्य केंद्र** शोधून त्यांच्याशी संपर्क साधा. बहुतेक गावांत किमान एक पशुवैद्य असतो.

**अतिरिक्त माहिती:**
जर गायीचे खाणे पूर्णपणे बंद झाले असेल आणि ताप असल्यास, हे खालील कारणांमुळे असू शकते:
- ताप (Fever)
- संसर्ग (Infection)
- पोटाची समस्या (Digestive problems)
- दुहेरी रोग (Double infection)

कृपया लवकरात लवकर पशुवैद्याचा सल्ला घ्या. गायीचे आरोग्य वाचवण्यासाठी वेळेत उपचार महत्त्वाचे आहेत.

तुम्हाला गायीच्या पोषणाबाबत किंवा इतर काही प्रश्नांसाठी मदत हवी आहे का?

parts.content:
गायीला ताप आणि खाणे बंद होणे हे गायीच्या आरोग्यातील एक गंभीर लक्षण आहे. याची योग्य तपासणी आणि उपचार करण्यासाठी खालील पायऱ्यांचे पालन करावे:

**१. तातडीने प्रशासकीय अधिकाऱ्याशी संपर्क साधा:**
